items.exampleEn: My grandfather likes to read the newspaper.
There is a big celebration in the city tonight.
items.exampleZh: 今晚城裡有盛大的慶祝活動。

items.exampleEn: Dear Amy, thank you for your letter.
items.exampleZh: 親愛的 Amy，謝謝你的來信。

items.exampleEn: My aunt is my mother's sister.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨是我媽媽的姊妹。

items.sentenceEn: My uncle and aunt live on a farm.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔和嬸嬸住在農場。

items.audioEn: Dear Grandpa, happy birthday! See you at the celebration.
items.audioZh: 親愛的爺爺，生日快樂！慶生會上見。

items.sentenceEn: My sister and her boyfriend are at the party.
items.sentenceZh: 我的姊妹和她男朋友在派對上。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather is ninety years old.

items.stemZh: 我媽媽的兄弟是我的舅舅。

items.passageEn: Dear Uncle Jack and Aunt Mary, thank you for coming to my birthday celebration. Grandpa was very happy to see you, and my girlfriend loved your cake! Please visit us again soon. Love, Tom
items.passageZh: 親愛的 Jack 叔叔和 Mary 嬸嬸：謝謝你們來參加我的慶生會。爺爺看到你們很開心，我女朋友也很喜歡你們帶來的蛋糕！請再來看我們。愛你們的 Tom

questions.questionZh: Tom 寫這封信是為了什麼？
options: 邀請他們一起去日本旅行
謝謝他們來參加慶生會

questions.questionZh: 誰很喜歡他們帶來的蛋糕？

rubricZh: 職業前加冠詞 a（例如 a teacher）

items.promptZh: 我們這個月會去看叔叔。
referenceEn: We will visit our uncle this month.
We are going to visit our uncle this month.
rubricZh: 「去看」可寫，例如 visit our uncle、go to see our uncle 等；所有格寫 our、my 等都正確
未來的計畫可寫，例如 will、be going to 等
